sources.quote: HD 192263, also named Phoenicia, is a star with an orbiting exoplanet in the equatorial constellation of Aquila.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 0.306 times the Sun's luminosity at 4,955 K, so 0.752 solar radii.
